development_screen: Verified primary full-coverage Jan-Apr ledger: all months nonnegative, arithmetic mean at least10%, at least10completed actual trades. Diagnostic routes cannot rescue a failed primary. This screen does not replace original case acceptance.
acceptance: May/July/September full net capital month arithmetic mean at least10%; all May-September months nonnegative and full coverage. No month-specific fitting or extra future observation period gate. Exposed historical data remain development regression.

V25 full-cash/dividend wait rule is not applied. All fees/slippage, dividends/splits, cross-month MTM and unknown-held occupation retained. Cash0 does not meet growth objective.

features: Current18state fields are deliberately excluded from raw prediction. Only semiconductor ownC/D labels are averaged; auxiliary returns do not enter mean. C/D are true ownETF stopped netlog returns, not index times3.

All prior20 required; no skip missing. Exact quote atdecision-30s and quote15min earlier. Historical bar available=end+1s assumption, not actual receipt.
